title: Momcozy New Modular Nesting 4 in 1 Compact Bottle Sterilizer and Dryer
bullets: Kindly note: This is a sterilizer and dryer for baby essentials, it does not include a washing function. This product is only suitable for US standard rated voltage 120V.

Compact Body, Spacious Capacity: Smaller by 19% than comparable models, the Momcozy bottle sterilizer and dryer fits up to 6 standard bottles and newborn essentials like pacifiers, toys, and pump accessories—freeing up your counter without compromising on space
8-Minute Full Steam Sterilization: In just 8 minutes, you can ditch boiling water or microwaves and feel confident your baby's feeding gear is always safe and ready when needed
72-Hour Safe Storage, Anytime Access: Keep bottles clean and ready for up to 72 hours, so you can feed your baby on your own schedule without worrying whether everything's still safe and fresh

Stackable Design for Easy Storage: With its clever nesting structure, the sterilizer tucks away neatly when not in use and is perfect for small kitchens or families who travel light but still want full functionality
Comes with Drying Rack: An extra rack helps you air-dry bottles right after washing—keeping your countertop neat and your feeding space organized
